_note: Ceilings for the CI probe (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job probe), which runs the optimised build (-c release -Xswiftc -DDEBUG). Set on 2026-10-18 from the numbers measured on the owner's M4 MacBook Air plus 25% (Documentation/PRODUCTION_READINESS_PROGRESS.md, 'Phase 7 measurements'). GitHub's macOS VMs have no GPU and draw in software, so CI may read higher than the Mac: if a first CI run fails only on these, raise each to its CI value + 25% and say so in Documentation/DECISIONS.md. A null ceiling isn't checked.
_hitches: scroll_hitches is null: GitHub's macOS runners have no GPU, so nearly every scroll frame there is over 33 ms (about 80 ms, see Documentation/HANDOFF.md) and the count says nothing about the app. Longest frame and CPU still count.
